## Summary

Describe the problem, the final change and who benefits from it.

## Change type

- [ ] Guide, evidence or case-study update
- [ ] Product Gallery or learning-site change
- [ ] Script or maintenance change
- [ ] Correction, accessibility or metadata improvement

## Evidence and validation

List the public source, reproducible input or command used to validate this change. State any limitations or details that were not independently verified.

## Public-content checklist

- [ ] I removed credentials, tokens, payment details, customer data and private operational information.
- [ ] I have the right to publish all submitted text and media under the repository license.
- [ ] I distinguished observed facts from estimates, interpretation and illustrative examples.
- [ ] I checked affected links, generated pages or scripts as appropriate.
- [ ] I read the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
